scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how she despises swallowing pills. Her doctor told her that if she didn’t take her medication, her next seizure would give her a severe headache. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I choke my aunt unconscious, I can make my aunt take her medication and she will not have to experience a severe headache. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience a severe headache.
outcomes: My aunt misses the scheduled dose of medication
My aunt experiences a severe headache
